name: EXTRAI
description: EXTRAI tests whether local LLMs (gemma4:12b/26b, qwen3:14b, qwen3.8:27b via Ollama, on consumer hardware) can redo the work of a published meta-analysis: cell-by-cell evidence extraction from all 14 of its randomized trials against a source-verified answer key (Study 1), and the meta-analytic arithmetic -- risk ratios, confidence intervals, pooling -- by head versus through a text-protocol calculator (Study 2). Includes pre-registered protocols with dated amendments, a dual reading-proof by number perturbation, fully mechanical grading with public adjudication records, and errata files for the anchor meta-analysis and for the adjudicator himself. Sibling of the FIEL summarization benchmark.
